title: Biology
description: ICSE Class X Biology: one theory paper of 2 hours carrying 80 marks (Section I 40 compulsory, Section II choose 4 of 6) plus 20 marks internal assessment of practical work.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ICSE Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Biology (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: Basic Biology (cell cycle, genetics); Plant Physiology (absorption, transpiration, photosynthesis, chemical coordination); Human Anatomy and Physiology (circulatory, excretory, nervous, sense organs, endocrine, reproductive systems); Population; Pollution.

sections.title: Biology
sections.description: Genetics, plant physiology, human physiology, population and pollution.

chapters.title: Cell Cycle and Cell Division
chapters.blurb: Interphase, mitosis stages, meiosis as reduction division, chromosome structure.

chapters.title: Genetics: Mendel's Laws and Sex-Linked Inheritance
chapters.blurb: Monohybrid and dihybrid crosses, sex determination, haemophilia and colour blindness.

chapters.title: Absorption by Roots
chapters.blurb: Imbibition, diffusion, osmosis, plasmolysis, root pressure, ascent of sap.

chapters.title: Transpiration
chapters.blurb: Process, significance, potometer, factors, potassium ion theory, adaptations, guttation.

chapters.title: Photosynthesis
chapters.blurb: Light and dark reactions, experiments, chloroplast structure, carbon cycle.

chapters.title: Chemical Coordination in Plants
chapters.blurb: Auxins, gibberellins, cytokinins, abscisic acid, ethylene; tropic movements.

chapters.title: Circulatory System
chapters.blurb: Blood, lymph, heart, blood vessels, double circulation, pulse and blood pressure.

chapters.title: Excretory System
chapters.blurb: Nephron structure and urine formation, dialysis, skin as an accessory excretory organ.

chapters.title: Nervous System
chapters.blurb: Neuron, brain and spinal cord, reflex action and reflex arc, voluntary and involuntary actions.

chapters.title: Sense Organs
chapters.blurb: Structure and working of the eye and ear, common defects of vision and hearing.

chapters.title: Endocrine System
chapters.blurb: Major endocrine glands, hormones, feedback control, related disorders.

chapters.title: Reproductive System
chapters.blurb: Male and female reproductive systems, menstrual cycle, birth control, reproductive health.

chapters.title: Population
chapters.blurb: Growth patterns, causes and consequences of population explosion, methods of control.

chapters.title: Pollution and Waste Management
chapters.blurb: Types of pollution, biodegradable and non-biodegradable waste, waste management practices.
